dataset_info.summary: Speeches given in Romanian at European Parliament plenary sessions, transcribed and segmented into utterances. One row is one such segment, scored against the normalised transcript. The speech is unscripted, accented and full of political and institutional vocabulary, which is exactly what makes it a hard, realistic board. Runs on this corpus are capped at 2,000 clips, drawn with a pinned seed so every fighter is scored on the same ones; a split smaller than the cap is scored in full.
dataset_info.notes: VoxPopuli ro test split — spontaneous European Parliament plenary speech, normalized_text as ground truth.
